# go-vectorstore

> Go vector-store library inspired by Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData, with typed model collections, native keys/data, named vectors and automatic embeddings across memory, SQLite and PostgreSQL/pgvector.

Requires Go 1.25+. Published version: v0.4.0. Master includes unreleased changes;
new sample commands are on master until the next tag. Prefer typed model APIs for
new applications. Original PostgreSQL Record APIs remain supported. Choose a
provider using its reported capabilities; accepted schema hints do not imply ANN
indexes or hybrid support. Deterministic sample embeddings are instructional.

## Start here

- [AI usage guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gabisonia/go-vectorstore/master/docs/ai-guide.md): Version guidance, complete runnable quickstart, task recipes and common mistakes.
- [Sample index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gabisonia/go-vectorstore/master/samples/README.md): Prerequisites, runnable commands and verification.
- [Released API reference](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/gabisonia/go-vectorstore/vectordata@v0.4.0): Public types and executable examples when present in that tag.
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gabisonia/go-vectorstore/master/CHANGELOG.md): Published and unreleased behavior.

## Usage and limits

- [Model API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gabisonia/go-vectorstore/master/docs/model-api.md): Tags, schemas, filters, embeddings, search, vectors, native values and iterators.
- [Provider matrix](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gabisonia/go-vectorstore/master/docs/parity.md): Backend capabilities and .NET workflow comparison.
- [SQLite](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gabisonia/go-vectorstore/master/docs/sqlite.md): Durability, concurrency and exact-scan costs.
- [Migrations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gabisonia/go-vectorstore/master/docs/migrations.md): PostgreSQL planning, explicit additive application and limitations.
- [Performance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gabisonia/go-vectorstore/master/docs/performance.md): Reproducible benchmarks and verification commands.

## Working code on master

- [Executable model examples](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gabisonia/go-vectorstore/master/vectordata/example_test.go): Typed CRUD/search, automatic embeddings, named vectors and errors.
- [Typed semantic search](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gabisonia/go-vectorstore/master/samples/typed-search/main.go): Filtered SearchText with selectable providers.
- [Typed RAG](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gabisonia/go-vectorstore/master/samples/typed-rag/main.go): Retrieved sources and opt-in generation.
- [Focused recipes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gabisonia/go-vectorstore/master/samples/recipes/main.go): Named vectors, cancellation, capability discovery, hybrid search and migration preview.
- [Repository agent instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gabisonia/go-vectorstore/master/AGENTS.md): Contributor setup, checks and invariants.
